disabledConfigFields.description:
The mapping for disabling fields in the UI for Implementation form configs
For each entry within map:
key = Form config name eg. 'ReliabilityMLConfig'
value = Collection of fields from this config which should be disabled on the UI eg. ['reliabilityRiskMLProjectId']

name: ReliabilityUIDisableFieldsConfig
